evidence.title: CCQ active-construction register identifies Microsoft L’Ancienne-Lorette Data Center
evidence.publisher: Commission de la construction du Québec
evidence.attribution: Commission de la construction du Québec
evidence.excerpt: CCQ's dated active-project register identifies Microsoft's data-centre construction at 6505 rue Yvon-Dolbec, L’Ancienne-Lorette, Quebec, Canada.

metadata.content_hash_scope: Exact content-decoded HTTP response body; not normalized text.
metadata.literal_pointer: PDF page 2, row code 914135; page heading and date footer.
metadata.date_semantics: June 8 is the date of the official active-project register, not an exact site inspection or commencement day. The source expressly lists projects in activity; past start dates and future/unknown finish dates are retained but do not independently establish this observation.
metadata.authority_basis: Primary public construction-industry regulator register, not a permit award, investment schedule or operator forecast. Current-status category is Liste des projets en activité and the named row states construction of a data centre.
metadata.scope: One existing development-project key and one campus. Phases are not additional sites; no aggregate four-location Microsoft total is counted.
metadata.rights_scope: Compact independently restated status/address facts only. No open licence is asserted for the CCQ register; no source PDF, table or financial quantities redistributed.
